name: read_files
description: Read several text files of your worktree in one call: 1 to 16 paths, relative to the root, in the order you give them. Each file comes behind a line that names it, then its numbered lines (the numbers of `read_file`): its first page, at most 400 lines or 8 KiB. A page that was cut ends with `[more: N lines left; next page: read_file path=<path> offset=K]`: read on with read_file. The whole result is at most 32 KiB: a file that did not fit is one line, `[not shown: read it alone with read_file path=<path>]`. A file that is not there, is binary or is not UTF-8 is one line that says why, and the other files are still shown. Read the manifest, the CI file and the other small files of a repository together with it. Example: {"paths":["Cargo.toml","justfile"]}

paths.description: Paths relative to the worktree root, in the order to show them (1 to 16)

repo.description: The slot to read in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.
